entity_data.name: Building Development
entity_data.description: Encompasses the planning, approval, and construction of new buildings and modifications to existing structures within the city, including school expansions and site plan amendments.

entity_data.name: Parking Issues
entity_data.description: Concerns related to parking availability, regulations, and infrastructure within the city, affecting residents, visitors, and businesses.

entity_data.name: Community Harmony
entity_data.description: Efforts and initiatives aimed at fostering positive relationships, cooperation, and peaceful coexistence among community members.

entity_data.name: sewer system
entity_data.description: The sewer system includes the network of pipes, treatment facilities, and related infrastructure used for the collection and disposal of sewage and wastewater within the city.

entity_data.name: charges for services
entity_data.description: Fees and charges levied for various city services, including sewer services, which may be determined by gauging, metering, or other approved methods, and may vary based on usage or other factors.

entity_data.name: sewage disposal
entity_data.description: The process and facilities involved in the treatment and disposal of sewage, including regulations for industrial and manufacturing premises to prevent undue burden on disposal systems.

entity_data.name: rates, fees and charges
entity_data.description: The schedule of rates, fees, and charges for sewer services, which are established after public hearings and notices, and may include additional charges for industrial sewage that imposes an unreasonable burden.

entity_data.name: public hearing
entity_data.description: A formal meeting held by the city commission to discuss and determine sewer service rates, fees, and charges, with proper notice given at least ten days prior to the hearing.

entity_data.name: sewer revenue bonds
entity_data.description: Municipal bonds issued to finance sewer infrastructure projects, payable from sewer system revenues, with details on issuance and repayment procedures.

entity_data.name: Sign Pollution
entity_data.description: Concerns related to the visual pollution caused by excessive or large signage, including billboards and oversized signs, impacting city aesthetics and environment.

entity_data.name: Signage Importance
entity_data.description: The significance of signage in identifying buildings, especially in commercial real estate, and its role in navigation, marketing, and city identity.

entity_data.name: Sign Size and Impact
entity_data.description: The effects of sign size on visibility, city aesthetics, and pollution, including discussions on reducing sign dimensions to mitigate visual clutter.

entity_data.name: Zoning Code Text Amendment
entity_data.description: An amendment to the zoning code that involves changes to the text, affecting permitted, conditional, or prohibited uses within a zoning category. Public notice and hearings are required, especially if affecting a limited number of property owners within an area. Initiated either by the City or other entities, with specific public notice requirements including publication in a newspaper of general circulation.

entity_data.name: Variances
entity_data.description: Applications for variances involve modifications to existing zoning regulations, typically requiring public notice and hearings. Variances may be initiated by the City or other applicants, with specific notice periods and publication requirements. They are often associated with specific property sizes, such as contiguous acres, and may involve public hearings if required.

entity_data.name: Use Change
entity_data.description: Changes in the designated use of a property within a zoning district. This process may involve amendments to permitted uses, conditional uses, or prohibited uses within a zoning category. Public notice and hearings are typically required, especially if the change affects a limited number of property owners or involves significant modifications.

entity_data.name: Campus Master Plan
entity_data.description: A comprehensive plan for the development and modification of a university campus district. The plan includes public notices and hearings, with a typical review period of around 10 days. It involves modifications to existing campus layouts, facilities, and land use, aiming to guide future development in accordance with city and university goals.

entity_data.name: Signs
entity_data.description: Regulations and standards related to signage in the city, including signage placement, size, and content to ensure safety, accessibility, and aesthetic consistency.

entity_data.name: Zoning Code
entity_data.description: Legal framework governing land use, building regulations, and spatial organization within the city to promote organized development and land utilization.

entity_data.name: Real Estate
entity_data.description: Activities, regulations, and market conditions related to buying, selling, leasing, and managing property within the city.

entity_data.name: Compliance Requirements
entity_data.description: Legal standards and regulations that entities must adhere to, including those set by the Department of Business Professional Regulation (DBPR) and other authorities, affecting various city operations.

entity_data.name: Impact on Commercial Real Estate
entity_data.description: Effects of regulations, signage, zoning, and other policies on the commercial real estate market, including leasing, development, and business location decisions.

entity_data.name: Walkability
entity_data.description: The measure of how friendly an area is to walking, including sidewalk quality, safety, signage, and proximity of amenities to promote pedestrian activity.

entity_data.name: Parking
entity_data.description: Regulations, availability, and management of parking facilities within the city to support transportation needs and urban mobility.

entity_data.name: Utility Conversion
entity_data.description: Conversion from overhead to underground utility distribution service, including procedures for notification, deadlines for completion, and enforcement measures.

entity_data.name: Underground Utility Service Facilities
entity_data.description: Facilities related to underground utility services, including the requirements for converting overhead utilities to underground systems and related legal and administrative procedures.

entity_data.name: historic preservation
entity_data.description: Efforts to preserve, protect, and maintain historical sites, buildings, and artifacts within the city to retain its cultural identity and history.

entity_data.name: landmarks
entity_data.description: Significant physical structures or sites recognized for their historical, cultural, or architectural importance within the city.

entity_data.name: uniformity
entity_data.description: The standardization of visual elements such as lighting, color schemes, and design features across city infrastructure to create a cohesive appearance.

entity_data.name: infrastructure
entity_data.description: The physical structures and facilities (such as roads, lighting, utilities) that support the city's operations and services.

entity_data.name: Legal Notices

entity_data.name: Publication Requirements

entity_data.name: Online Notices
